allow: PowerShell($h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:8001/health; $h | Format-List; Write-Output '---synthesize---'; $body = @{ text = "Hello, my name is Markus." } | ConvertTo-Json; $resp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:8001/synthesize -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'; $resp | Select-Object format, sample_rate, audio_ms, timing_source | Format-List; "phoneme count: $\($resp.phonemes.Count\)"; "audio_b64 length \(chars\): $\($resp.audio_b64.Length\)"; Write-Output '---first 10 phonemes---'; $resp.phonemes | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table)

PowerShell($body = @{ text = "Hello." } | ConvertTo-Json; $raw = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8001/synthesize -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -UseBasicParsing; $json = $raw.Content; [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString\([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\($json\)\) | ConvertFrom-Json | ForEach-Object { $_.phonemes } | Format-Table @{n='p_codepoints'; e={ \($_.p.ToCharArray\(\) | ForEach-Object { 'U+{0:X4}' -f [int][char]$_ }\) -join ',' }}, p, t0_ms, t1_ms -AutoSize)
